items.title: 33.4 Insani sargarmiyon se pani ki aaloodgi (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 33.4 (PDF 254-255). Quick Check answers were written for the lesson and need review.

blocks.text: Insan ki sargarmiyan (human activities) poori duniya mein pani ki pollution ki bari wajah hain. Aabadi barhti hai aur industries phailti hain to zyada waste aur pollutants pani mein jate hain. Waste ka ghalat intezam (improper waste management) aur mahol ke qawaneen (environmental regulations) ki kami ki wajah se aksar gandagi daryaon, jheelon aur samandaron tak pohanch jati hai.

Industry pani ki pollution ka sab se bara source hai. Factories aksar nuqsan-deh chemicals, heavy metals aur zehreela waste seedha daryaon, jheelon aur samandaron mein daal deti hain. Pollution phailane wali aam industries: oil refineries, chemical plants, gariyon ki industry (automobile), fertilizer (khaad) ki factories aur tanneries (chamra rangne ke karkhane) waghera.

Kheton se behta pani (runoff) fertilizers, pesticides aur herbicides qareeb ke pani mein le jata hai; is tarah kheti pollution mein bara hissa dalti hai. Ghalat tareeqe ki aabpashi (irrigation) se mitti zyada katti hai (soil erosion) aur mitti (sediments) daryaon aur naalon mein beh jati hai. Bohat se ilaqon mein kheton ka nikasi ka pani (drainage) pollutants le kar zameen ke oopar ke pani (surface water) aur zameen ke neeche ke pani (groundwater) dono ko ganda karta hai.
3. Domestic and Municipal Waste (gharon aur shehron ka kachra)

Gharon aur shehron ka waste pani ki pollution ke bare sources mein se ek hai. Bohat se ilaqon mein shehron ka bina saaf kiya ya kam saaf kiya gaya sewage aur thos kachra seedha daryaon, jheelon ya samandaron mein daal diya jata hai, jis se nuqsan-deh bacteria aur viruses pani mein aa jate hain. Gharon ka waste, jaise detergents, tel aur chemicals, naaliyon mein ja kar aakhir pani tak pohanchta hai. Khaas taur par plastic aksar naaliyon aur nehron mein ya un ke qareeb phenka jata hai, jis se raaste band (blockage) hote hain aur lambe arse ki pollution hoti hai.
4. Deforestation aur shehri taraqqi ke liye zameen ka istemal

Darakht katne (deforestation) aur zameen ke istemal se pani ki pollution kafi barhti hai. Jab darakht aur sabza hata diye jate hain to mitti dheeli ho jati hai aur jaldi katti hai, is liye daryaon aur naalon mein mitti (sediment) barh jati hai. Yeh mitti pani ke raaste band karti, aabi maskan (habitats) kharab karti aur pani ki quality girati hai. Shehron ki taameer (construction) bhi behte pani mein pollutants aur malba (debris) daalti hai.

Kashti chalana (boating), tairaki aur camping ka theek intezam na ho to yeh bhi pollution phailati hain. Kashtiyan aksar tel, fuel aur doosre chemicals pani mein chhorti hain jo aabi zindagi ko nuqsan dete hain. Sayyah (visitors) plastic, khane ke rapper aur doosra kachra phenk kar jheelon aur daryaon ko ganda karte hain.

Jahaz aur kashtiyan tel, fuel aur doosre chemicals chhor kar pani ko ganda karte hain. Tel ka hadsati girna (oil spill) aur jahazon ka ganda pani aur sewage pollution ki bari wajah hain. Jahaz ki aam dekh-bhaal, jaise us ke dhanche (hull) ki safai aur rang (painting), bhi zehreele maddey pani mein chhorti hai. Yeh sab mil kar aabi zindagi ko nuqsan aur pani ki quality ko kharab karte hain.

Ek mulk mein darya teen ilaqon ke paas se guzarta hai: (1) dehi (rural) ilaqa jahan bohat bari kheti aur bohat maweshi (cattle) hain; (2) industrial ilaqa jahan paint aur battery ki bohat si factories hain; (3) bare shehar ka bara rihaishi (residential) ilaqa.

blocks.prompt: i. Dehi ilaqe mein darya mein kis qism ke pollutants jayenge: organic, inorganic ya dono? Do ke naam batayein.
blocks.explanation: Dono. Organic: maweshiyon ka gobar aur pesticides. Inorganic: fertilizers, jaise ammonium nitrate (NH₄NO₃) aur phosphates.

blocks.prompt: ii. Industrial ilaqe ke qareeb kaun si metals pani ko sab se zyada ganda karengi?
blocks.explanation: Paint aur battery ki factories se lead (Pb) aur cadmium (Cd); batteries se mercury (Hg) bhi ho sakti hai.

blocks.prompt: iii. Kaun se ilaqe aise chemicals dalenge jo eutrophication karte hain?
blocks.explanation: Dehi ilaqa (fertilizer wala behta pani aur gobar: nitrogen aur phosphorus) aur rihaishi ilaqa (sewage aur phosphate wale detergents).

blocks.prompt: iv. Rihaishi ilaqe ke qareeb pani ko ganda karne wali chaar cheezein batayein.
blocks.explanation: Misal: sewage (bacteria aur viruses ke saath), detergents, gharon ka tel aur chemicals, aur plastic ya thos kachra.

items: Insani sources: industry (sab se bara), kheti, gharon aur shehron ka kachra, darakht katna aur taameer, tafreeh, samandari naqal-o-hamal.
Waste ka ghalat intezam aur qawaneen ki kami gandagi ko daryaon aur samandaron tak pohanchati hai.
